Causal market-wide and ticker context at the HOT anchor may better identify which selected HOT episodes will develop a persistent, practically usable entry window. Once admitted, Request227's relative ENTER-vs-WAIT timing should choose the entry.

tradability_target.definition: Best mean Request227 multi-event continuation value across any two consecutive WATCH checkpoints from minutes 1 through 5.
tradability_target.reason: Require a persistent entry window rather than a single hindsight spike.

runtime_policy.within_admitted_episode: Use Request227 relative ENTER-vs-WAIT model only. ENTER at first nonnegative predicted advantage; otherwise WAIT through minute 5 then ABSTAIN.
